title: Drug given to prevent malaria sends 52 Andhra villagers to hospital; girl dead, 23 more children moved to Telangana
summary: Fifty-two of the 71 villagers given the anti-malaria tablets at Gollaguppa fell ill with vomiting and breathing difficulty; the Collector said all those in hospital were out of danger

title: Nepal flash floods: Over five tonnes of medicines, 11-member rescue team in India’s next tranche of aid
summary: India’s aid to Nepal comes as the death toil there rose to over 1,100 people on Wednesday (September 2, 2026)

title: Bombay High Court orders CBI probe into death of ex-celebrity manager Disha Salian
summary: The Court said that the CBI shall register an FIR and record the statement of the deceased’s father but no person shall be treated as an accused until and unless there is sufficient material

title: Modi, Shah, Naidu, Chiranjeevi wish Pawan Kalyan on 55th birthday; PM says he is driving NDA’s governance agenda in Andhra
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said Pawan Kalyan was at the forefront of the NDA’s governance agenda in Andhra Pradesh

title: M.S. Dhoni’s ₹100-crore defamation suit: Madras High Court directs Registry to number retired IPS officer’s plea
summary: G. Sampath Kumar has insisted that a judicial officer must be appointed to monitor the video recording of evidence by an advocate commissioner and that the recording must take place in a court premises or government building

title: Maternity leave cannot lead to loss of role or career prospects: Delhi HC
summary: Court directs Centre to frame rules or schemes within six months on workplace accommodation, protection of role and status, lactation support, and grievance redressal

title: Seven teams deployed to put out forest fire in Erode’s Kadambur Hills
summary: The forest areas in the STR have been experiencing severe dry conditions owing to the lack of rainfall over the past few months

title: Military Intelligence joins Army weapons theft probe
